integrity: The contradiction uses the source's own Definition 4 and Proposition 1. An exact-rational verifier checks the explicit baseline-parameter witness and the nonzero weighted increment; no numerical approximation is used to prove the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Corrects the existence of the source's declared nonzero constant equilibrium and the resulting homogeneous perturbation equation for genuinely time-varying weights. It does not classify the full nonautonomous weighted dynamics or challenge the constant-weight special cases.
title: A time-varying weight destroys the claimed constant cobweb equilibrium
